note: Pre-registered 2026-11-05 before any evaluation run; wave-2 questions (Q7-Q10) and Q6's move into scope were registered 2026-11-06 before their first run. Wording is natural, not definitional: part of what is tested is whether Claude picks the right definition. {ORDER_NUMBER} is substituted at run time from eval/out/truth.json (never committed). Q11 (revenue by SKU, wave 3) and its alternative readings (drafts included; credit notes ignored; tax-inclusive) were registered 2026-11-06 before its first run. For Q11 the treatment arm gets a fresh cache directory on rep 1 (cold) and reuses it on later reps (warm); results are reported cold and warm separately.

questions.text: As of 2026-11-05, how many sales have an overdue unpaid invoice balance, and what is the total overdue amount? Ignore voided sales.
What was the total invoiced revenue by sales channel for sales ordered between 2026-07-01 and 2026-09-30 inclusive? Ignore voided sales.
Who are the top 3 customers by total invoiced amount across all non-voided sales, and how much is each?
What is the total value of stock on hand across all locations, and which location holds the most value?
How many distinct products currently have negative available stock (summed across all locations)?
How many purchase orders are still awaiting receipt of goods? Ignore voided and completed ones.
How many open sales have not been picked yet? Open means not voided and not completed.
How many open sales are packed but not yet shipped? Open means not voided and not completed.
How many products that have a reorder point set are at or below it, counting available stock summed across all locations (a product with no stock rows has 0 available)?
For sale {ORDER_NUMBER}: what is the order total, and has it shipped yet?
Which 3 SKUs have the highest invoiced revenue excluding tax, and how much did each bring in? Ignore voided sales.
